# Final Execution Tranche

The Awtsmoos renews the whole city one truthful street at a time; Awtsmoos.com will be measured, repaired, reread, tested, and only then called bright.

## A — Close Sefarim

Readback current entry/active-search/presentation contract; enforce <=120 lines; run focused + full suite; browser-test the real query route at desktop/tablet/430px/short-height; inspect console/network/overflow/focus/context/search options; measure cold/warm resources.

## B — Sitewide Discovery

Harvest route census; run existing runtime-quality crawler over the classified public registry; merge current Git/mission ownership; write ranked route-debt ledger.

## C — Rolling Repairs

For each highest-impact clean/unclaimed route family: read complete owner graph; write plan delta; rewrite complete small files; reread; focused tests; browser interactions/layout; performance; full matrix rerun; continue.

## D — Compact/Performance Infrastructure

Trace `ayzarim/awtsmoosDynamicServer` compact implementation and benchmark representative JS/CSS normal vs compact for semantics, MIME, status, bytes, latency, cache headers. Adopt only measured safe gains. Source remains readable.

## E — Release

Full repository secret/risk scan; fetch/topology; stage all safe requested changes including unrelated work; commit; refresh concurrent delta; follow-up commit if necessary; push GitHub; verify remote SHA; execute actual deploy; production smoke/performance; push release fixes/receipts if needed.

## Completion Gate

No completion claim until actionable route debt is empty or externally blocked, relevant tests/browser/performance gates pass, the complete safe snapshot is on GitHub, deployment uses it, and production evidence agrees.

## NEXT_ACTION

Observe all currently running jobs and immediately execute the first safe evidence-derived action.
